name: blackraptor-marketing
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates: they judge the work and record a cited verdict, machine-checked as it is written. A governed, full-stack marketing department: specialist agents (brand, naming/trademark, content, copy, creative, SEO/GEO, paid media, social/community, email/outbound, video, analytics) hub-and-spoke around a shared Marketing Intelligence Core context file. Draws on published methodology (Dillman survey design, Kohavi experimentation, IPA/Binet & Field creative effectiveness, Ehrenberg-Bass distinctive assets, Made to Stick / NN-g writing craft), cited as sources and not an endorsement by or affiliation with their authors; including trademark/name research, a compliance-gated claims engine, and pricing/willingness-to-pay modeling. Auto-pulls the blackraptor-core pack (evidence-auditor adversarial research gate + research-integrity skill + product-manager). Hard rules baked in: no autonomous sends, posts, or spend — agents draft, humans approve.
